close_reason: Extracted validate_email_body(obj_val) from build_email_from_create: body structure validation (bodyStructure/textBody/htmlBody/attachments exclusivity, type checks, validate_body_part) is now its own documented function. build_email_from_create reduced from ~175 to ~100 lines.
description: email.rs build_email_from_create: the function spans ~170 lines (lines 1415-1590) and interleaves mailboxIds parsing, keyword validation, inReplyTo/references parsing, thread assignment (async backend call), body structure validation, and email construction. A reader who wants to understand 'what validation happens on Email/set create' must read all 170 lines. Splitting into extract_email_addresses, validate_body_structure, and a thin build_email_from_create that orchestrates them would make each concern independently testable and reviewable. This is a readability issue not an elegance issue because the lack of separation makes code review harder.
title: build_email_from_create is 170 lines mixing validation and construction
